name: Third Street Promenade
description: Third Street Promenade is an iconic pedestrian-only shopping, dining, and entertainment destination in the heart of Downtown Santa Monica, just blocks from the beach. This vibrant open-air promenade features a diverse mix of national retailers, local boutiques, restaurants, and street performers, making it one of Southern California's most popular outdoor gathering spots. The Promenade hosts year-round special events including holiday festivities, ice skating, and California's first Entertainment Zone allowing outdoor alcoholic beverages from participating businesses.
summary: A premier pedestrian-only lifestyle destination in Downtown Santa Monica featuring diverse shopping, dining, entertainment, and year-round special events just blocks from the Pacific Ocean.
